prompts.hero: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original wide key art for the ARC-SHIFT action game's main menu, 16:9 landscape. Create a premium illustrated science-fantasy environment and a small original wandering arcanist, painterly anime environmental art with crisp architectural edges, quiet atmospheric depth and selective warm light. Composition: left 42 percent is dark midnight blue negative space with only subtle distant ruins for menu text; the visual story occupies the right 58 percent. On the right, an immense broken circular observatory above a misty turquoise sea, silver ivory pylons and brass orbital instruments, pale flowering branches growing through an abandoned station, a narrow bridge leading into an amber beacon. A small back-facing white-cloaked traveler holding a slim cyan arcblade stands at the right lower third, dwarfed by the architecture. Refined material shading, restrained bloom, luminous sea fog, elegant rhythmic silhouettes, dark navy foreground, ivory highlights, desaturated jade and pale gold accents. Sophisticated exploration mood, not grim medieval horror. Original design only; no recognizable franchise characters or logos. No text, no UI, no lettering, no watermarks. Important: left space must be genuinely usable behind a readable menu.
